attributes.action: Include Spouses of British Citizens in Medical Training Priority Group from 2027
attributes.additional_details: From 2027, UK specialty training will prioritise applicants based on immigration status. Doctors married to British citizens who have the right to live and work in the UK are building their lives here. Their careers can support the NHS, UK, British partners and households financially. Careers should support the families we love, not force us to choose between family and career or leave the UK to pursue training. We ask the Government to include them in the priority group this round and onwards.
attributes.background: Doctors married to British citizens who can legally live and work in the UK want to build careers, contribute to the NHS and support their families. They should not have to choose between their career and family, or be forced apart to pursue medical training. Include them in the 2027 priority group.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/784723
